summary: Full backend and frontend testing of Kurdyukov Aparts landing page. All 14 backend API tests pass (health, weather, rooms, reviews, leads CRUD+persist, chat with multi-turn continuity, chat history). Frontend critical flows all verified end-to-end: hero with real OpenWeather data, quick booking lead capture, 5 rooms with modal+book button, heart favorite, AI concierge chat, Bnovo widget iframe, header navigation and mobile menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat history replay strategy in /app/backend/server.py:373-386 re-sends every prior user message into LlmChat on each turn -- this is O(N) re-API calls per request and will become slow and expensive as chat history grows. LlmChat with the same session_id should already persist context server-side; consider not replaying or limiting to a windowed summary.
/api/leads endpoint has no rate limiting or basic anti-spam; anyone can POST unlimited leads to MongoDB.
/api/leads GET endpoint is unauthenticated -- it exposes all customer phone numbers and PII publicly. This is a HIGH severity privacy issue but was not in test scope; flagging for main agent.
Weather cache is in-process module-level dict (_WEATHER_CACHE) -- fine for single worker but if backend is scaled with multiple uvicorn workers, each will hit OpenWeather independently.
QuickBookingForm has no error UI when createLead fails -- only console.error. User would see button stuck on 'Отправляем...' (actually it un-sticks but no visible error message).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed leads in MongoDB via tests (test_create_lead_and_persist, test_create_lead_minimal) and via frontend Playwright (TEST_Анна). Created chat session and messages via pytest chat tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All API endpoints under /api prefix work. Real OpenWeather currently returns 'Дождь +9°' for SPB. Bnovo widget loads inside #book section as iframe. AI concierge Александр responds in Russian using GPT-5.2 via Emergent integrations. Frontend uses data-testid extensively: hero-section, hero-weather-badge, hero-check-in/out/guests, hero-check-availability, hero-lead-form, hero-lead-name/phone/submit/success, room-card-*, room-modal, room-modal-book/close, room-fav-*, ai-fab, ai-panel, ai-input, ai-send, ai-close, ai-messages, ai-suggestion, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, header-book-cta, nav-link-*.
